scope: tool manifest, supply-chain, capability, and tool-output poisoning against the AgentOS tool gateway; detection/quarantine evidence only
out_of_scope: executing third-party tools or real malware
trust_boundaries: Tool manifests arrive from publishers/registries: untrusted until provenance-verified.
Tool outputs are untrusted external content regardless of manifest validity.
Detector outputs are evidence, never authority.
Only gateway policy over registered state authorizes effects.
adversary_goals: register a poisoned or misleading tool manifest
smuggle capabilities or effect-class escalation past the registry diff
inject instructions through tool output to expand authority, override policy, exfiltrate, or request secrets
claim governance facts (knowledge promotion, approvals, budget, reconciliation, acceptance) from external content
degrade or blind detectors (timeout, crash, malformed, disagreement)

TP-MANIFEST-STRUCT.name: manifest structural abuse
TP-MANIFEST-STRUCT.atlas_grounding: AML.T0051 (LLM prompt injection) delivery via tool surface; CWE-74 injection into agent-interpreted fields

TP-MANIFEST-SUPPLY.name: supply-chain integrity abuse
TP-MANIFEST-SUPPLY.atlas_grounding: AML.T0010.000 (poisoned dependency); SLSA v1.1 provenance gaps; NIST SP 800-218 PO.3/PO.5

TP-OUTPUT-DIRECT.name: direct instruction injection in tool output

NM-BENIGN-UNUSUAL.name: benign unusual but declared (near miss / false positive pressure)

layered_controls: L4 static indicators and content classifiers (ADVISORY ONLY)
L6 output taint/sanitization and secret/exfiltration guard
authority_invariants: external content can never expand capabilities, policy, approvals, ownership, budgets, knowledge state, or goal acceptance
no positive heuristic score may compensate for an authorization, provenance, critical-poison, or fail-closed violation
scanner/detector disagreement, timeout, crash, or malformed output fails closed
uncertain effect-capable behavior is denied, quarantined, or routed to explicit human review
residual_risks: novel poisoning patterns outside frozen indicator families may require routing-level defense (quarantine/human review) rather than detection
small frozen corpus measures only the declared classes; metrics do not generalize to production
deterministic evaluator cannot emulate adaptive adversaries or statistical detectors
